title: Use whole completed loops to keep a mediator fault locally correctable
statement: On the full admitted Pauli bus support, temporal C_a(X),C_b(Z),C_a(X),C_b(Z)=CZ_ab tensor I_M without bus initialization, even for correlated input. Seven local closed Steane-block loops and a dense parity schedule both use28 contacts and implement logical CZ. A bus fault inside one local loop has source error span{I,Z_Ai,Z_Bi,Z_Ai Z_Bi} with distinct measured syndromes; the dense schedule admits one undetected logical Z and error1 on the specified input.

requires: Completed admitted fault locations, fixed acquired frames/source code and implemented source syndrome/recovery; count every returning coherent bath
For reusable logical CZ: repeated diagonal controlled-Pauli source/bus ports on the full admitted bus support; a changed architecture from downstream-only erasure
provides: A source-reported internally accepted schedule-sensitive exact logical-operation construction
assumptions: Corrects the declared one-loop/global coherent error support, not arbitrary many faulty loops
Label flips, contact/source faults outside the factorization, undefined leaked bus ports and noisy syndrome circuits need their own contracts
The316-contact ideal full cost is not a noisy workload certificate; direct transversal coupling remains stronger when available
costs: Finite10/6 construction:20 source-field contacts,5 Bell CNOT/5 H/10 readouts,44 CNOT+1 SWAP encoder and inverse decoder,18 syndrome contacts plus preparation/reset/feedforward
Closed logical-CZ full ideal netlist ends at recovered encoded outputs:316 bus contacts,198 H,14 source qubits and6 bus reset/readout cycles; unencoding additional
Weak-noise bound requires all-input interaction norms eta_j, not marginal infidelity; extensive-radius code search/decoding and dense checks may be expensive
contract.units: Controlled Pauli contacts, actual syndrome bits, ideal logical half-diamond error and separately qualified full circuit costs.
contract.obstruction: Equal memory and core gate counts do not determine causal source-error exposure or safe mediator reuse.

Returning quantum baths count as physical cut memory. Capture, source encoding/storage/control, syndrome extraction/reset and leakage/loss continuation are acquired or separately bounded. This is a conditional operation separation, not a physical threshold or advantage over conventional fault-tolerant computing. Seven direct transversal CZ gates beat the bus when those ports are supplied. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions.
